# Empty, `any`, `none` and single members.
builder
prim any any
prim i integer
prim none none
uinter empty n=Empty
members empty any
inter withany any,i n=WithAny
inter withnone none,i n=WithNone
inter nested withany,i n=Nested
cls top e:empty,a:withany,n:withnone,x:nested n=Top
top Top top
finish
resolve debug
print

# An intersection of a single type with attributes keeps them; nested
# intersections are flattened into one group, and constraints intersect.
builder prov
prim i integer mm=1:5
prim d double mm=0:10
str s unrestricted ml=2:
str s2 unrestricted ml=:8
inter one i n=One desc=only
inter n1 i,d n=N1
inter n2 n1,d n=N2
inter strs s,s2 n=Strings
cls top o:one,n:n2,s:strs n=Top
top Top top
finish
query recmembers 6 intersect
resolve debug
print
